description.value: Basic Goodness Pizzeria brings wood-fired Neapolitan pizza to the surf town of Tofino, BC, offering licensed dine-in service on a first-come, first-served basis with no reservations. Alongside pizza, the menu includes salads, cocktails, and a rotating selection of wine and beer. Local delivery is available through a Tofino delivery service, and takeaway is offered when the kitchen can accommodate it.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business at 551 Campbell Street, Tofino, with a matching phone number. The contact page explicitly describes takeaway service ('Online Ordering + Takeaway will be offered on a case by case basis') and licensed dine-in with wood-fired Neapolitan pizza and salads. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by the website, so Wi-Fi is left null; no bike parking, washroom, or water-refill evidence appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag conflicts with the website: the two pages of the website also contradict each other on hours. OSM data may be stale; recommend a manual hours update.
OSM tags include internet_access=wlan but the website makes no mention of Wi-Fi; left unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Neapolitan pizza restaurant in Tofino with a live website and confirmed contact details. A natural stop for touring cyclists on the Tofino peninsula.

wow_evidence: wood-fired Neapolitan pizza to the surf town of Tofino
